description_zh: 此接口用于新增外呼任务
name: CloudCreateTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心id
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The task name. The value must be URL-encoded in UTF-8 format and be up to 50 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码，长度小于50字
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The task description. The value must be URL-encoded in UTF-8 format and be up to 200 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 任务描述；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码，长度小于200字
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the outbound task. The task type cannot be changed after creation.

`1`: Predictive outbound task.

`2`: Automated outbound task
parameters.help_zh:
外呼任务创建后任务类型不支持修改。
1：预测外呼任务。
2：自动外呼任务
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the task template.

You can use a template to centrally manage task parameters and simplify interface calls. Multiple tasks can share the same template. In your interface call, you only need to provide parameters that differ from the template.

Parameter precedence: Parameters provided in the interface call take precedence.

Example: If you specify `autoStart=1` and `templateName=testTemplate` in an interface call, the `autoStart` value from the call is used. If you do not specify the `autoStart` parameter or provide an empty value for it, the value from the template is used.

Use the task template interface to manage task templates
parameters.help_zh:
任务模板名称。
通过任务模板可以实现对任务参数的统一管理以及简化接口传参，多个任务可以使用同一个模板管理参数，接口只需要传入任务间有差异的参数。
参数生效规则：接口传入的参数优先。
示例说明：如果接口传了参数autoStart=1和参数templateName=testTemplate，接口传入的参数autoStart生效。如果接口未传入autoStart参数或者传入的autoStart参数是空值，那么模版中的参数生效。

任务模板可通过任务模板接口进行管理
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to schedule the task to start automatically.

`0`: Disabled. (Default)

`1`: Enabled.

If you set this parameter to `1`, the `autoStartDay` and `autoStartTime` parameters take effect. At least one of them is required
parameters.help_zh:
定时开始，默认关闭。
0：关闭
1：开启

值为1时autoStartDay和autoStartTime参数才生效，并且至少设置其中的一个
parameters.name: auto_start

parameters.help_en: The scheduled start date for the task. This parameter takes effect only when `AutoStart` is set to `1`. If you do not specify this parameter, the task starts on the current day at the time specified by `autoStartTime`. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd`. Example: `2017-01-01`
parameters.help_zh: 定时开始日期；autoStart=1时生效。参数不传入时默认在当天的autoStartTime定时启动。格式：yyyy-MM-dd，如：2017-01-01
parameters.name: auto_start_day

parameters.help_en: The scheduled start time for the task. This parameter takes effect only when `AutoStart` is set to `1`. If you do not specify this parameter, the start time defaults to `00:00:00` on the date specified by `autoStartDay`. Format: `HH:mm:ss`. Example: `08:00:00`
parameters.help_zh: 定时开始时间；autoStart=1时生效。参数不传入时默认在autoStartDay的00:00:00定时启动。格式：HH:mm:ss，如：08:00:00
parameters.name: auto_start_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to schedule the task to stop automatically.

`0`: Disabled. (Default)

`1`: Enabled.

If you set this parameter to `1`, the `autoStopDay` and `autoStopTime` parameters take effect. At least one of them is required
parameters.help_zh:
定时完成，默认关闭。
0：关闭；
1：开启

值为1时autoStopDay和autoStopTime参数才生效，并且至少设置其中的一个
parameters.name: auto_stop

parameters.help_en: The scheduled stop date for the task. This parameter takes effect only when `AutoStop` is set to `1`. If you do not specify this parameter, the task stops on the current day at the time specified by `autoStopTime`. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd`. Example: `2017-01-01`
parameters.help_zh: 定时完成日期；autoStop=1时生效。参数不传入时默认在当天的autoStopTime定时完成。格式：yyyy-MM-dd，如：2017-01-01
parameters.name: auto_stop_day

parameters.help_en: The scheduled stop time for the task. This parameter takes effect only when `AutoStop` is set to `1`. If you do not specify this parameter, the stop time defaults to `23:59:59` on the date specified by `autoStopDay`. Format: `HH:mm:ss`. Example: `17:00:00`
parameters.help_zh: 定时完成时间；autoStop=1时生效。参数不传入时默认在autoStopDay的23:59:59定时完成。格式：HH:mm:ss，如：17:00:00
parameters.name: auto_stop_time

parameters.help_en:
Whether to forcibly end the task at its scheduled stop time. This parameter takes effect only when `AutoStop` is set to `1`.
Valid values:
parameters.help_zh: 定时完成时强制结束任务；autoStop=1时生效。0.关闭 1.开启，默认关闭。开启配置后，当任务到定时完成时间时无论任务中的号码是否已经呼完，均将任务状态设置为结束。适用于对数据有呼叫时间限制的场景。注：任务在结束状态时无法再次启动
parameters.name: force_end_flag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the call schedule type. This parameter is used with the `autoStart` and `autoStop` parameters. Use interval calling if the task must run only during specific time periods each day. By default, calls are made continuously.

`0`: Continuous calling.

`1`: Interval calling
parameters.help_zh:
配合定时开始（autoStart）和定时结束（autoStop）参数使用，如任务需要在每天的特定时间段内呼叫则开启间隔呼叫方式。默认连续呼叫。
0：连续呼叫
1：间隔呼叫
parameters.name: auto_task_type

parameters.help_en:
The time periods for interval calling. This parameter is required when `AutoTaskType` is set to `1`. It specifies the time condition IDs for the call periods. Separate multiple IDs with commas (`,`). Example: `9,22`.

Call the interface that queries time condition settings to obtain the list of time conditions
parameters.help_zh:
间隔呼叫时间段；autoTaskType=1时必填。呼叫的时间段配置。参数格式：时间条件编号。支持多个，多个使用英文","逗号隔开，如：`9,22`。

时间条件列表可通过查询时间条件设置列表接口获取
parameters.name: auto_trigger_time_strategy

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically complete the task.

`1`: Enabled. After all numbers in the task are called, the task is automatically completed and its status is set to `Ended`.

`0`: Disabled. After all numbers in the task are called, the task is automatically paused and its status is set to `Paused`.

A task in the `Ended` state cannot be restarted
parameters.help_zh:
默认开启。
1：开启；任务中的号码呼叫完后，任务自动完成，状态设置为结束。
0：关闭；任务中的号码呼叫完后，任务自动暂停，状态设置为暂停。

任务在结束状态时无法再次启动
parameters.name: auto_complete

parameters.help_en:
The retry strategy.

Basic Mode

Data structure: A JSON object. Example: `{"retry":2,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"1-1-1"},{"round":2,"time":"2-2-2"}]}`

Format description: `retry` specifies the number of retry attempts. `round` specifies the retry attempt number. `time` specifies the interval for the retry attempt in `D-H-M` format, where `D` is days, `H` is hours, and `M` is minutes.

Advanced Mode

This mode requires the "Number Status Recognition" service to be enabled.
     Data structure: A JSON array. Example: `[{"condition":{"sipCause":[710,719]},"retry":1,"sort":1,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"0-0-10"}]},{"condition":{"sipCause":[800]},"retry":1,"sort":2,"strategy":[{"round":2,"time":"0-0-10"}]}]`

Format description: `condition` specifies the retry condition. `sort` specifies the priority of the retry condition. Other fields are the same as in Basic Mode.

The system automatically identifies the mode based on the provided parameter format. When retrying based on the first call time, the interval for each subsequent round must be longer than the previous one
parameters.help_zh:
重试策略；
【基础模式】： 

    - 数据结构为Json格式：```{"retry":2,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"1-1-1"},{"round":2,"time":"2-2-2"}]}```
    - 格式说明：retry是重试次数，round是第几次重试，time是第几次重试间隔的时间：1-1-1，第一个1是天，第二个1是小时，第三个1是分钟。

【高级模式】：
    - 高级模式需要开启「号码状态识别」服务数据结构JsonArray格式 ：```[{"condition":{"sipCause":[710,719]},"retry":1,"sort":1,"strategy":[{"round":1,"time":"0-0-10"}]},{"condition":{"sipCause":[800]},"retry":1,"sort":2,"strategy":[{"round":2,"time":"0-0-10"}]}]```
    - 格式说明：condition是重试条件，sort是重试条件的顺序，其余字段与基础模式一致。

基础模式和高级模式的区分根据传入的参数格式自动识别。基于首次呼叫时间重试时，每轮的重试时间必须大于上一轮的时间
parameters.name: retry_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The time reference for the retry strategy. This parameter takes effect only when a retry strategy is configured.

`1`: Based on the first call time. (Default)

`2`: Based on the last call time
parameters.help_zh:
重试策略时间类型；配置重试策略时生效。 
1：基于首次呼叫时间
2：基于上次呼叫时间，默认基于首次呼叫时间
parameters.name: retry_strategy_time_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the task is valid only for the current day.

`0`: Disabled. (Default)

`1`: Enabled. Deletes both numbers pending retry and numbers pending calls.

`2`: Enabled. Deletes only numbers pending retry.

`3`: Enabled. Deletes only numbers pending calls
parameters.help_zh:
任务仅当天生效；
0：关闭
1：开启，删除待重试的数据和待呼叫的数据
2：开启，删除待重试的数据
3：开启，删除待呼叫的数据，默认关闭
parameters.name: retry_strategy_only_today

parameters.help_en:
Example: `{"strategy":[{"sort":1,"type":"retryCall", "desc":0},{"sort":2,"type":"firstCall","orderType":0}]}`

- `sort`: The priority order for calling numbers pending retry versus numbers not yet called.

`type`: The category of numbers to prioritize. Valid values: `retryCall` (numbers pending retry) and `firstCall` (numbers not yet called).

`desc`: Used when `type` is `retryCall`. Determines the order for retrying calls.

    - `0`: Prioritizes numbers with fewer retry rounds (e.g., Round 1 is called before Round 2).

    - `1`: Prioritizes numbers with more retry rounds (e.g., Round 5 is called before Round 4)
parameters.help_zh:
数据结构为Json格式```{"strategy":[{"sort":1,"type":"retryCall", "desc":0},{"sort":2,"type":"firstCall","orderType":0}]}```
格式说明：
    - sort：是重试号码和未呼叫号码的呼叫顺序；
    - type：retryCall重试号码、firstCall未呼叫号码当type=retryCall；
    - desc：
        - 0优先呼叫待重呼轮次数值较小的号码，即轮次靠前（如第1轮、第2轮）的号码先被呼叫；
        - 1优先呼叫待重呼轮次数值较大的号码，即轮次靠后（如第5轮、第4轮）的号码先被呼叫当type=firstCall时，orderType：随机呼叫，0顺序(优先级) ；1随机；2顺序(导入时间)
parameters.name: call_priority_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The type of caller ID to display to customers.

`1`: Landline number.

`2`: Mobile number.

`4`: Number pool.

`5`: Caller ID navigation.

We recommend using caller ID navigation for flexible control over your caller ID strategy. Other types will be deprecated
parameters.help_zh:
客户侧外显号码类型；
1：外显固话
2：外显手机号
4：外显号码池
5：外显导航

推荐使用外显导航，可以灵活调整和控制外显策略。其他类型将逐步下线
parameters.name: customer_clids_category

parameters.help_en: A list of caller IDs to display. This parameter is required when `CustomerClidsCategory` is `1` or `2`. Separate multiple numbers with commas (`,`). This parameter is not recommended
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显号码列表；customerClidsCategory=1或2时必填。支持多个，多个直接使用英文逗号','分隔。不建议使用
parameters.name: customer_clids

parameters.help_en:
The rule for selecting a caller ID. This parameter takes effect when `CustomerClidsCategory` is `1` or `2`. This parameter is not recommended.

`1`: Random. (Default)

`2`: By area code
parameters.help_zh:
客户侧外显规则；customerClidsCategory=1或2时生效。默认随机。不建议使用
1：随机
2：按区号
parameters.name: customer_clid_type

parameters.help_en: The caller ID selection rule details, specified as a JSON object. This parameter takes effect when `CustomerClidType` is `2`. It defines rules such as the default area code and whether to match provincial capitals. Example: `{"defaultAreaCode":"010", "isMatchCapital":"1"}`. This parameter is not recommended
parameters.help_zh: 外显规则；customerClidType=2时生效。Json格式，外显号码选择规则：默认区号，是否匹配省会等；如：{"defaultAreaCode":"010", "isMatchCapital":"1"}。不建议使用
parameters.name: clid_property

parameters.help_en:
Whether to enable weighted distribution for caller IDs. This parameter takes effect when `CustomerClidsCategory` is `1`. This parameter is not recommended.

`0`: Disabled. (Default)

`1`: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
外显号码比例配置开关；customerClidsCategory=1时生效。默认关闭。不建议使用。
0：关闭
1：开启
parameters.name: customer_clid_weight_flag

parameters.help_en: The weighted distribution configuration for caller IDs, specified as a JSON array. This parameter takes effect when `CustomerClidsCategory` is `1` and `CustomerClidWeightFlag` is `1`. Example: `[{"number":"123,345","weight":"5"}, {"number":"567,789","weight":"5"}]`. This parameter is not recommended
parameters.help_zh: 外显号码比例配置内容；customerClidsCategory=1且customerClidWeightFlag=1时生效。JsonArray格式 [{"number":"123,345","weight":"5"}, {"number":"567,789","weight":"5"}]，不建议使用
parameters.name: customer_clid_weight

parameters.help_en: The name of the number pool or the identifier of the caller ID navigation. This parameter is required when `CustomerClidsCategory` is `4` or `5`
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显号码池名称或外显导航标识；customerClidsCategory=4或5时必填。customerClidsCategory=4时customerClidsGroup传号码池名称。customerClidsCategory=5时customerClidsGroup传外显导航标识
parameters.name: customer_clids_group

parameters.help_en: The customer timeout duration, in seconds. Default value: `30`. Value range: `5` to `60`
parameters.help_zh: 客户超时时间；单位秒数，默认30秒，取值范围5 ~ 60
parameters.name: customer_timeout

parameters.help_en:
`1`: Direct to agent. After the customer answers, the call is immediately routed to an agent. If no agents are available, the call can overflow to an IVR (if configured) to ensure a direct connection experience for high-priority customers.

`2`: AI-to-agent transfer. After the customer is connected, the call is first routed to an AI bot configured in the IVR. The call is transferred to an agent based on the interaction result. This increases automation and reduces labor costs
parameters.help_zh:
1：直连座席。直连座席模式：客户接听后直接分配座席，无空闲座席可溢出语音导航（需配置语音导航），保障高优先级客户直连体验。
2：AI转人工。AI转人工模式：客户接入后，优先进入语音导航中配置的智能体机器人，按交互结果决定是否转接座席，提升自动化覆盖率，降低人工成本
parameters.name: call_route_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IVR. Specify either `IvrId` or `IvrName`. `IvrId` takes precedence if both are provided. For automated outbound tasks, one of these two parameters is required.

Predictive outbound task use case: If an agent is not available within a specific time (default: 2 seconds) after the customer answers, the call overflows to the IVR to queue for an agent. The system also supports overflowing to the IVR if an agent does not answer a transferred call (requires enterprise-level configuration).

Automated outbound task use case: The IVR to which the call is transferred after the customer answers.
parameters.help_zh: 语音导航Id；参数ivrId和ivrName二选一，同时传入时ivrId生效，在创建自动外呼任务时ivrId或ivrName必选其一。预测外呼使用场景：如果客户接听后未在特定时间内（默认2秒）找到可用座席，通话将溢出到语音导航继续排队找座席。同时支持在呼转座席，座席未接听时也溢出到语音导航，需要开启企业配置生效自动外呼使用场景：客户接听后，转到的语音导航
parameters.name: ivr_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the IVR. Specify either `IvrId` or `IvrName`. `IvrId` takes precedence if both are provided. For automated outbound tasks, one of these two parameters is required
parameters.help_zh: 语音导航名称；参数ivrId和ivrName二选一，同时传入时ivrId生效，在创建自动外呼任务时ivrId或ivrName必选其一
parameters.name: ivr_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of concurrent calls for the task. If `Type` is `1`, setting this parameter to `0` removes the limit. We recommend configuring this parameter if you have fewer than 10 agents
parameters.help_zh: 任务维度限制最大并发数，实际并发不会超过最大并发限制。type=1时，配置成0表示不限制，座席数量少于10时建议配置该参数
parameters.name: concurrency

parameters.help_en:
Custom task fields, specified as a JSON array. Each element in the array can only contain one key-value pair. If an element contains multiple pairs, only the first pair is used. Example: `[{"name":"1234"},{"name1":"12345"}]`. The default is null.
The value of a single field cannot exceed 1,000 characters
parameters.help_zh: 任务自定义字段。JsonArray格式；数组的每个元素只支持传递一组键值对，传递多组只取第一组，如 {"key", "value"}。 默认空值，示例：[{"name":"1234"},{"name1":"12345"}] 注：单个字段值的长度不能超过1000个字符
parameters.name: user_fields

parameters.help_en:
Agent channel variables, specified as a JSON array. You can specify a maximum of five variables. Example: `[{"name":"abcdefg","value":"${cdr_enterprise_id}"}]`. The default is null. The variables are passed to the agent channel as SIP headers.
The value of a single field cannot exceed 1,000 characters
parameters.help_zh: 座席通道变量。JsonArray格式；最大支持5个变量。默认空值， 示例：[{"name":"abcdefg","value":"${cdr_enterprise_id}"}] 注：单个字段值的长度不能超过1000个字符。变量会以SIP_HEADER的形式设置到座席侧通道
parameters.name: call_variables

parameters.help_en:
The time condition IDs for periods when calls are prohibited. Separate multiple IDs with commas (`,`). Example: `9,22`.
Call the interface that queries time condition settings to obtain the list of time conditions
parameters.help_zh: 禁呼时间；在特定的时间段内禁止呼叫。参数格式：时间条件编号。支持多个，多个使用英文","逗号隔开，如：9,22。注：时间条件列表可通过查询时间条件设置列表接口获取
parameters.name: time_strategy

parameters.help_en:
Whether to automatically delete the oldest completed task when the maximum task limit is reached.
`autoDelete` is not a task attribute. It takes effect only during this specific interface call.

`0`: Disabled.

`1`: Enabled. The oldest completed task is automatically deleted
parameters.help_zh:
任务数超出最大任务数限制时，是否自动删除已完成的最早创建的任务，值为1代表自动删除。注：autoDelete不是任务属性，只在接口调用时生效
0：关闭
1：自动删除
parameters.name: auto_delete

parameters.help_en:
The method for specifying agents.

`1`: By agent ID list. (Default)

`2`: By agent group.

You cannot change this parameter after the task is created
parameters.help_zh:
指定座席方式；
1：座席工号列表
2：外呼组，默认座席工号列表

任务创建后不支持修改
parameters.name: call_group_type

parameters.help_en:
The agent IDs. This parameter is required when `CallGroupType` is `1`. Separate multiple agent IDs with commas (`,`).
An agent can be part of only one running task at a time
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号列表；callGroupType=1时必填。支持多个座席工号，多个之间使用英文逗号','分隔注：一个座席只能在一个运行中的任务中
parameters.name: cnos

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the agent group. This parameter is required when `CallGroupType` is `2`.
An agent group can be assigned to multiple tasks, but it can be active in only one running task at a time
parameters.help_zh: 外呼组号；callGroupType=2时必填。注：一个外呼组可以绑定到多个任务，但只能同时运行一个任务中
parameters.name: agent_group

parameters.help_en:
The agent allocation strategy.

`1`: Random. (Default)

`2`: Sequential.

`3`: Longest time since last call (time elapsed since the last call ended).

`4`: Longest idle duration (time elapsed since the agent last switched to the `Idle` state)
parameters.help_zh:
座席分配规则；默认随机。
1：随机
2：顺序
3.座席未进线最大时（从上一次呼叫结束到当前的总时长）
4.座席状态[空闲]最长时长（座席最近一次切换为空闲状态的持续时长）
parameters.name: call_strategy

parameters.help_en: The agent timeout duration, in seconds. Default value: `10`. Value range: `5` to `60`
parameters.help_zh: 座席超时时间；单位秒数，默认10秒，取值范围5 ~ 60
parameters.name: agent_timeout

parameters.help_en: The agent wrap-up time, in seconds. Default value: `30`. Value range: `1` to `10800`. A longer wrap-up time reduces the number of calls in each batch
parameters.help_zh: 座席整理时间；默认30秒，取值范围1～10800，整理时间会影响每次呼叫的个数，值越大，呼叫号码个数会减小
parameters.name: wrapup

parameters.help_en: The maximum allowed idle time for an agent, in seconds. Default value: `40`. Value range: `10` to `600`. During task execution, if the average agent idle time exceeds this value, the number of calls per batch increases
parameters.help_zh: 座席最长等待时间；默认40秒，最小10，最大600，允许座席空闲的最大时间。任务执行过程中，如果座席平均空闲时间大于maxWaitTime，每次呼叫个数会增加
parameters.name: max_wait_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of available agents. Default value: `10`. Value range: `1` to `10`. If the number of available agents in the task drops below this value, the task is automatically paused to prevent nuisance calls
parameters.help_zh: 最小可用座席数；默认为10，取值范围1 ~ 10。任务内可用座席数小于当前值时，任务自动暂停，避免骚扰
parameters.name: min_available_agent_count

parameters.help_en: The nuisance control ratio. Default value: `1`. Value range: `(0, 20]`. Supports up to two decimal places. A smaller value results in fewer calls, while a larger value increases the number of calls and improves agent utilization
parameters.help_zh: 骚扰率；默认值为1，取值范围为大于0，小于等于20，支持小数，精确到小数点两位。值越小呼叫的号码越少，值越大呼叫的号码越多，座席利用率越高
parameters.name: quotiety

parameters.help_en: The over-dial rate. Default value: `100`. Value range: `50` to `400`
parameters.help_zh: 超呼率；默认值为100，取值范围50～400
parameters.name: predict_adjust

parameters.help_en:
The daily call limit per agent, specified as a JSON array. Example: `[{"cnos":["2000","2001"],"limit":"5"}]`.
To use this feature, you must enable it in your enterprise configuration. The system starts tracking the daily call count only after the feature is enabled and a limit is set
parameters.help_zh: 座席当日接听的通话个数上限，使用方式详见下方说明；JsonArray格式 [{"cnos":["2000","2001"],"limit":"5"}注：使用座席当日接听数限制功能需开启企业配置，功能开启并且配置上限后系统才开始统计当日接听数
parameters.name: call_limit_strategy

parameters.help_en: The music on hold for the customer. This audio plays while the customer waits for an agent. The default is silence. You can use public or enterprise audio files. Specify the path of the audio file
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧等待音；客户接听后呼叫座席，等待座席接听时播放的语音，默认为空白音。支持公共语音和企业语音，值为语音文件的path
parameters.name: customer_moh

parameters.help_en: The audio prompt for the customer. This audio plays after the customer answers and before the call is transferred to an agent. The system starts searching for an agent after the prompt finishes playing. By default, no prompt is played. Specify the path of a public or enterprise audio file
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧提示音；客户接听后呼转座席前播放的语音，提示音播放完成后再找座席，默认无提示音。支持公共语音和企业语音，值为语音文件的path
parameters.name: customer_voice

parameters.help_en: The initial estimated answer rate for customers. Default value: `50`. Value range: `1` to `100`. During the warm-up phase, the call frequency is calculated based on this rate
parameters.help_zh: 初始化预计客户接通率；默认50，取值范围1～100，预热阶段的呼叫，按照此接通率计算呼叫频率
parameters.name: answer_rate

parameters.help_en: The task warm-up duration, in seconds. Default value: `300`. Value range: `60` to `600`
parameters.help_zh: 任务预热时间；默认300秒, 取值范围60 ～ 600
parameters.name: warm_up_duration

parameters.help_en:
Whether to re-warm up the task after it is paused.

`0`: Disabled.

`1`: Enabled. (Default)
parameters.help_zh:
暂停后重新预热；默认开启，任务暂停后是否需要重新预热。
0：关闭
1：开启
parameters.name: is_rewarm
